title: 포트폴리오 조회
description: Cloudflare D1 조회 기록을 10분마다 복사한 로컬 SQLite. 봇과 본인 기기(?me=1)는 뺌.

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS 조회 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND date(ts, '+9 hours') = date('now', '+9 hours')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS 조회 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND date(ts, '+9 hours') = date('now', '+9 hours')

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS 조회 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS 조회 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT org) AS 네트워크 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT org) AS 네트워크 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', max(ts), '+9 hours') AS 마지막 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', max(ts), '+9 hours') AS 마지막 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts, '+9 hours')) AS INTEGER) - 32400 AS time, CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS site, count(*) AS value FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts, '+9 hours')) AS INTEGER) - 32400 AS time, CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS site, count(*) AS value FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS 사이트, count(*) AS 조회, count(DISTINCT org) AS 네트워크, strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', max(ts), '+9 hours') AS 마지막 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS 사이트, count(*) AS 조회, count(DISTINCT org) AS 네트워크, strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', max(ts), '+9 hours') AS 마지막 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 AND status = 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', ts, '+9 hours') AS 시각, CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS 사이트, country || ' ' || city AS 지역, org AS 네트워크, referrer AS 앞페이지 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', ts, '+9 hours') AS 시각, CASE WHEN length(path) > 38 THEN substr(substr(path, 39), 1, instr(substr(path, 39) || '/', '/') - 1) WHEN path = '/' THEN '(첫 화면)' ELSE path END AS 사이트, country || ' ' || city AS 지역, org AS 네트워크, referrer AS 앞페이지 FROM views WHERE bot = 0 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
